axes.label: Self-only spell reflection and Magic mitigation
Party temporary current and maximum health
Self-only Fear and talent-dependent snare removal
Self-only Disease, Poison, and Curse removal

notes: Pummel handles interruptible casts and stuns provide non-lockout stops. Disrupting Shout adds a fourteen-yard area lockout but also taunts everything it hits.
Fearless can remove eligible Paralyzing Shots from the Warrior; Bitter Immunity is self-only backup for Regurgitate or Mass Envenom, not party cleanse coverage.
Bitter Immunity can remove Toxic Spew only from the Warrior.
Berserker Rage with Fearless removes snares, not Bloodthorn Roots; WHELP does not treat it as root freedom.
Bitter Immunity is a long-cooldown self answer to Toxic Spores.
Fearless can remove an eligible snare such as Frigid Roar, but cannot replace group dispel coverage.
Bitter Immunity can self-cleanse Heartstop Poison or Curse of Doom.
Shockwave and other stops can interrupt susceptible Seduction channelers, but unlike Pummel they do not lock the spell school.
Bitter Immunity can remove the named Poisons from the Warrior and Fearless can remove eligible Violent Sand slowing.
Reflectability is mechanic-specific; Spell Reflection remains personal Magic mitigation when a cast cannot be reflected.
Bitter Immunity is self-only backup for Poison or Curse mechanics.
Shockwave, Storm Bolt, and Intimidating Shout affect only susceptible enemies and are not replacements for Pummel on lockout-sensitive casts.
Bitter Immunity can self-cleanse Poison Nova, Lingering Fluid, or Serpent Strike; it cannot cleanse allies.
Fearless provides self snare removal while stuns help control susceptible Animated Gold.
Fearless can remove eligible Cold Claws slowing from the Warrior.
The guide names no Disease, Poison, or Curse requirement here; Bitter Immunity is not promoted to generic Magic cleansing.

recommendations: Shockwave controls clustered orbs and Pummel or Storm Bolt can cover stragglers. Disrupting Shout is another area answer, with a taunt side effect.
Swap immediately to the priority enemy and use Avatar for damage when it is available.
Use Charge or Heroic Leap mobility to collect an orb without carrying it away from teammates.
The guide recommends Avatar or Victory Rush to help overcome the application; neither is a party dispel, so coordinate healing and real dispels.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of Pumps's Patch 12.1.0 Protection Warrior Mythic+ utility and affix guidance. The source repeats generic utility across dungeons, so canonical WHELP mechanic typing supplies examples without attributing invented encounter tips to the author.
